nodes.summary: A bitstring $s$ is a feasible solution of a MAX-CUT instance $x$ exactly when the length of $s$ equals the vertex count $\lfloor \sqrt{|x|} \rfloor$ of $x$, so that $s$ has one bit per vertex.
nodes.title: Feasible MAX-CUT solutions

nodes.summary: The vertex count of a MAX-CUT instance, a bitstring $x$ of length $|x|$, is $\lfloor \sqrt{|x|} \rfloor$.
nodes.title: Vertex count of a MAX-CUT instance

nodes.summary: If $\mathsf{P} \neq \mathsf{NP}$, then the optimization problem MAX-CUT does not admit a polynomial-time approximation scheme.
nodes.title: MAX-CUT has no PTAS unless P = NP

nodes.summary: Let $x$ be a MAX-CUT instance with vertex count $n = \lfloor \sqrt{|x|} \rfloor$ and let $s$ be a bitstring, with bits indexed from $0$. If $s$ is a feasible solution of $x$ (its length is $n$), the value of $s$ is the number, as a rational number, of pairs $(i, j)$ with $i < j < n$ such that bit $i n + j$ of $x$ is true and bits $i$ and $j$ of $s$ differ; otherwise the value is $0$.
nodes.title: Value of a MAX-CUT solution

nodes.summary: MAX-CUT is the optimization problem whose instances are bitstrings $x$, read as an adjacency matrix on $n = \lfloor \sqrt{|x|} \rfloor$ vertices in which, for $i < j < n$, bit $i n + j$ of $x$ (bits indexed from $0$) says whether $\{i, j\}$ is an edge. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
